result.summary: Review complete. The function’s end-exclusive range now includes the final valid window, and checks behave correctly for empty/short/equal-size inputs, nonpositive sizes, floats, strings, None, and bool. Full unittest discovery passes (3 tests). The remaining blocking gap is that committed tests do not exercise the newly documented non-integer/bool validation or shorter-than-size behavior. VERDICT: FAIL.

findings.details: The committed suite does not assert that non-integer sizes (including bool) raise TypeError, nor that inputs shorter than size return an empty list, although these are explicitly documented behaviors and validation was added in this change. Manually exercised cases behave as documented; the gap is in automated regression coverage.
findings.title: Missing regression coverage for validation and short inputs

risk.why: Contained utility behavior change; implementation and the existing boundary tests pass, but the newly documented input-validation behavior lacks committed coverage.
